description: Defines the ConceptReferenceTerm class, representing a reference term for medical concepts within the OpenMRS system, including fields for source, code, version, and related mappings.

classes.name: ConceptReferenceTerm
classes.description: Represents a term used to reference concepts from external terminologies, including attributes for source, code, version, and mappings.

methods.name: getConceptReferenceTermId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this ConceptReferenceTerm.

methods.name: setConceptReferenceTermId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this ConceptReferenceTerm.

methods.name: getConceptSource
methods.description: Returns the ConceptSource associated with this reference term.

methods.name: setConceptSource
methods.description: Associates a ConceptSource with this reference term.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Retrieves the code used to identify the reference term within its reference terminology.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code for this reference term.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the reference term.

methods.name: setVersion
methods.description: Sets the version of the reference term.

methods.name: getConceptReferenceTermMaps
methods.description: Returns the set of ConceptReferenceTermMap objects linked to this reference term.

methods.name: setConceptReferenceTermMaps
methods.description: Sets the collection of ConceptReferenceTermMap objects.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of this object (alias for getConceptReferenceTermId).

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier for this object (alias for setConceptReferenceTermId).

methods.name: addConceptReferenceTermMap
methods.description: Adds a new ConceptReferenceTermMap to this term's collection, avoiding duplicates and self-mapping.

methods.name: removeConceptReferenceTermMap
methods.description: Removes a specified ConceptReferenceTermMap from the collection.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation combining the name and code of the reference term.
